opportunity.title: Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) Bridge Notice of Intent to Sole Source
opportunity.description: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency intends to issue a sole-source bridge IDIQ contract to Leidos for Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) under RFO 6.103-1(c)(2), supporting the FS2 program through April 2028 until a competitive follow-on IDIQ can be awarded. Scope: continued integration, software maintenance, operations support and limited development for current mission capabilities of the Source Directorate, across Mapping, Charting and Geodesy mission areas: aeronautical, maritime, topographic, geopolitical geography, elevation, geodesy and controlled imagery.

profile.pastPerformance: Service-disabled veteran-owned. Prime on two VA software maintenance contracts (about $2.1M and $3.4M) and one Army National Guard web portal ($650K).
profile.capacityNotes: Twenty-two staff. Active facility clearance (Secret). SOC 2 Type II report current. Strong VA customer references.
verification: NAICS codes confirmed against USAspending reference (api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/references/naics) on 2026-10-16.
Set-asides follow SBA definitions: SBA = small business, 8A = 8(a) Business Development, HUBZONE, WOSB/EDWOSB, SDVOSB.

checks.reason: Full and open competition; no set-aside required.

rationale.point: The opportunity is a sole-source bridge IDIQ intended for award to a single contractor through April 2028 (Claim #1), which strongly favors an incumbent contractor not identified as Blue Ridge.

The planned follow-on FS2 IDIQ is a single-award five-year contract (Claim #2), making this bridge a short-term precursor; responding with a capability statement could position the company for the future full competition.

risks: Sole-source justification likely points to an incumbent; Blue Ridge is not indicated as the incumbent.
Median award size for DoD NAICS 541511 is ~$150M, far exceeding Blue Ridge's 22-person capacity and past contract values ($2.1M, $3.4M, $650K).
Set-aside is NONE, so SDVOSB status does not confer eligibility advantage for this specific action.
Short response deadline (2026-10-25) limits time to assemble a compelling capability statement.
nextSteps: Submit a capability statement to the contracting officer before the due date expressing interest and highlighting relevant VA/Army National Guard software maintenance past performance, Secret clearance, and SOC 2 compliance.
Request the sole-source justification documentation to assess protest viability.
Monitor for the follow-on full-and-open FS2 IDIQ competition (five-year period per Claim #2) as a more viable target for a prime bid.
